claim: A reusable, topology-only schematic of a three-clone tumor tree for the fixed K=3 model setting.

semantic_contract.unique_claim: K=3 fixes the number of clone nodes for a run; this component shows one rooted three-clone topology and does not encode local fractions or posterior support.
semantic_contract.reading_order: Read the rooted topology from C1 through C3.
semantic_contract.visual_encoding: Dark blue lines encode parent-descendant relations. Orange circular marks identify clone nodes. Node count encodes K=3; equal node size is categorical and does not encode fraction. The light-blue canvas matches the fixed-K model panel so the reusable nested SVG has no white block.
semantic_contract.quantitative_claims: Exactly three clone-node marks are displayed, so K=3. The tree has one tumor founder C1 and two direct descendants C2-C3. No η or φ values are asserted.
semantic_contract.topology_rule: C1 is the single founder; C1 parents C2 and C3. Edge length is schematic and has no time or fraction scale.
semantic_contract.overlap_policy: Tree edges intentionally meet clone-node marks as structural connections. Clone labels sit outside the visible orange marks.

asset_inventory.dimensions: 83×93 PNG, transparent background, visible orange glyph retained
asset_inventory.reuse: three times with preserved aspect ratio; node size is categorical only
